findings.original: After splitting the two outer essentially constant systems, the proof invokes TR3 for a projection triangle map at the first index.
findings.adverse_evidence: In D^b(k), the first triangle k->0->k[1]->k[1] with identity boundary has no comparison to k->k->0 inducing identity on k; all subsequent identity triangles do.
findings.correction: Compute both off-diagonal blocks. Constant-to-pro-zero vanishes at every index; pro-zero-to-constant vanishes only on a further tail. Take that tail before applying TR3.
findings.limits: The statement and all hypotheses survive. The error is in the unconditional first-index projection claim, not in essential constancy of the middle system.

adverse_interpretations_not_counted_as_d.issue: A retraction is used to construct a complement without global idempotent completeness.
TR3 supplies adjacent cone maps, and cone cohomology extends one degree below the input interval.
